description: This file contains test functions for the emoji API in the Mattermost server, including creation, retrieval, deletion, listing, searching, and autocomplete of emojis.

methods.name: TestCreateEmoji
methods.description: Tests the creation of emojis, including handling of disabled feature, duplicates, size constraints, invalid data, permissions, and different image formats.

methods.name: TestGetEmojiList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of emojis, including empty list, pagination, deletion filtering, and sorting.

methods.name: TestGetEmojisByNames
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple emojis by their names, including handling of non-existent and excessive requests.

methods.name: TestDeleteEmoji
methods.description: Tests deleting emojis, including permissions, non-existent emojis, and deletion of others' emojis with various permission levels.

methods.name: TestGetEmoji
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific emoji by ID.

methods.name: TestGetEmojiByName
methods.description: Tests fetching an emoji by its name.

methods.name: TestGetEmojiImage
methods.description: Tests retrieving the image data of emojis in various formats and error cases.

methods.name: TestSearchEmoji
methods.description: Tests searching emojis with different terms, prefix matching, and error handling.

methods.name: TestAutocompleteEmoji
methods.description: Tests autocomplete functionality for emojis based on search terms, including no matches, empty terms, and logged-out scenarios.
